race.comment: SHE'S A JETT (5) resumes. She's a lightly raced mare who was good in three runs last time in, the maiden win coming as favourite on a soft 6 at Warrnambool. Drawn low and can measure up. NEW YORK SCANDAL (12) got home fairly at Pakenham Synthetic last start and has claims despite a tough draw. OF THE VIEW (7) is a query on very heavy but handles soft fine and can give a sight. MR CHARISMATIC (11) comes right into the mix after some key scratchings. Not dismissing.
